recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast black and white studio portrait of a shirtless male figure with dreadlocks and tattoos, leaning against a luxury vehicle. The composition uses a low-angle perspective to emphasize stature, set against a neutral, desaturated gray background with a pop of deep red in the script lettering.
coreVisualRelationships: The figure's verticality anchors the right third of the frame.
The luxury car's grille provides a strong geometric counterpoint to the organic form of the subject.
The red script typography creates a focal point that breaks the monochrome palette.
Low-angle lighting emphasizes muscle definition and metallic textures.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Full-body figure positioned on the right, occupying approximately 60% of the vertical height.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The front grille of the luxury car in the center-left foreground.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the subject's face, moves down the body to the car, then sweeps left to the red script title.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Ample open space in the upper left quadrant to accommodate primary typography.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Neutral grays and deep blacks (photographic base)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast with zero saturation in the image, contrasted by high saturation in the red text.
paletteRestrictions: Strictly monochrome except for one accent color

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Combination of a geometric sans-serif and an elegant formal script.
letterConstructionRules: Sans-serif: wide tracking, uniform stroke weight, all-caps.
Script: fluid, continuous strokes, high slant, varying line weight.
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'C' in the script is oversized and serves as a decorative flourish.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast between a rigid, wide-tracked sans-serif and a fluid, organic script.
graphicDevices: Parental advisory block in bottom left corner

preserve: The red color of the script

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the wide, clean aesthetic of the secondary text.
Captures the elegant, flowing nature of the primary title.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a black and white photograph of a man with dreadlocks leaning against the front of a luxury car with a prominent vertical grille. Use a low-angle shot and a plain gray studio background.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add the primary title in a deep red formal script in the upper left. Place the artist name in a wide-tracked white sans-serif centered at the top.

verificationChecks: Is the image strictly black and white?
Is the script text the only source of color?

adjustableVariables: Amount of grain in the photograph
Tracking width of the sans-serif text
mustRedesign: Specific brand logos on the car
Exact facial features of the subject

avoid: Color bleeding from the red text

postGenerationChecks: Verify the red script is legible against the gray background.
Check that the car grille does not distract from the subject's face.
Ensure the low-angle perspective is maintained.
Confirm the sans-serif text has sufficient letter-spacing.
recipe.reuseFormula: Monochrome Portrait + Luxury Object + Script/Sans-Serif Contrast Typography
